reason: I already have my brand that I reorder when it runs out, and I'm not going to switch just because a TikTok shows a nice sachet. The lab report is a good touch, but it doesn't give me a reason to change what already works for me.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when others have 8 forms in one capsule? It feels like I'd be paying for a simpler thing and a pretty package.
would_change_my_mind: A creator I trust showing real results after 30 days, or a cheap trial of a few sachets to try next to my current one.
